title: Independence review — Norris & Chen LLP
instructions: Norris & Chen LLP audits **Keystone Logistics** (a private company) and **Vireo Pharmaceuticals** (an SEC registrant). Evaluate each situation under the applicable independence rules.

exhibits.title: Situations
exhibits.content:
1. A Keystone audit senior's spouse holds Keystone stock through a self-directed brokerage account.
2. A Norris & Chen tax manager (not on the Keystone audit, different office) spends 4 hours on a Keystone tax question.
3. Keystone's CFO designated a qualified controller to oversee Norris & Chen's preparation of Keystone's statements.
4. Vireo's audit committee asks Norris & Chen to perform Vireo's internal audit function.
5. Norris & Chen prepares Vireo's corporate tax returns with audit committee pre-approval.
6. The lead partner on Vireo has served six consecutive years.
7. A Vireo audit senior joined Vireo as controller three months after the last audit ended; the next audit period is already under way.
8. Keystone owes Norris & Chen fees for tax work completed 14 months before the current report date.

rows.label: 1. Spouse's Keystone stock
rows.explanation: Immediate family's direct financial interest impairs independence.

rows.label: 2. Tax manager, 4 hours
rows.explanation: Not a covered member (under 10 hours, not on the team or in the lead partner's office).

rows.label: 3. Statement preparation with a qualified overseer
rows.explanation: Permitted nonattest service when the general requirements are met.

rows.label: 4. Internal audit for Vireo
rows.explanation: Internal audit outsourcing is prohibited for issuer audit clients.

rows.label: 5. Vireo tax returns with pre-approval
rows.explanation: Tax compliance is permitted with pre-approval (absent PCAOB rule violations).

rows.label: 6. Lead partner, six years
rows.explanation: Lead partners may serve at most five consecutive years.

rows.label: 7. Controller within the cooling-off period
rows.explanation: A financial reporting oversight role within the one-year cooling-off period.

rows.label: 8. Fees unpaid for 14 months
rows.explanation: Fees unpaid for services rendered more than one year before the report date.
